key_poses:
Use case: illustration-story / production animation key poses.
Reference image 1 is the authoritative exact ArcPet Neco-Arc model and cel drawing style. Reference image 2 is the current desktop idle model for proportions and palette. Recreate THIS character, never redesign into a baby or an oversized bobblehead. Straw-golden jagged bob and cowlick, brown cat ears with white inner ears, cream oval eyes with red slit pupils, peach face, white plain long-sleeve top, navy skirt, charcoal thick short legs, large brown boots, golden curved cat tail. Fine warm outlines and simple broad flat cel shadows. Head and torso must join naturally: chin overlaps the TOP of her white collar; no visible gap, no floating head, no head pasted on a headless model. Head width about1.25times shoulder width, not twice shoulder width.
Create ONE transparent animation storyboard sheet with EXACTLY6 complete scene drawings, 3columns x2rows, identical camera, framing, scene scale and tabletop position. Each scene: entire WHOLE CHARACTER drawn coherently behind a small walnut study desk, seated on a small stool behind it. Desk is in FRONT of character's waist, skirt and legs. A tiny brown gooseneck lamp stands far LEFT of table, switched OFF; a tiny terracotta pot with3 simple white daisies/yellow centers stands far RIGHT. ONE closed dark-green hardcover book lies flat in CENTER. View nearly frontal with only a little top surface visible. Desktop is at seated lower chest. The cat's torso is clearly BEHIND the back edge of table, never in front of the desk. Her sleeves extend naturally forward over the table edge and PAWS alone hold the book ABOVE tabletop. Closed book stays entirely on tabletop, never on or below front apron. Legs can be visible in the opening BELOW the apron, hanging from a stool located behind desk; boots must never protrude through tabletop, apron or desk legs.
Chronological6poses: 1 standing directly BEHIND desk, paws relaxed, stool just behind, closed book on table. 2 lowering onto stool, knees bend, head-body proportion unchanged. 3 seated upright, tiny breathing expansion of chest and relaxed shoulders, closed book still flat on table. 4 both paws reach FORWARD and touch book sides on tabletop. 5 lifts closed book to chest, bending elbows without arm collision or neck gap. 6 opens book slightly tilted toward face, eyes calmly down on pages. No looking-up movement, no blink needed in these keys. Calm small cat-shaped mouth, no huge smile. Both eyes parallel down gaze, not cross-eyed.
Each keyframe is a coherent WHOLE person and scene painting: do not split body parts into separate pieces; no cutout neck or arbitrary costume changes. Ensure shoulders retain width, head size/color identical, torso length fixed, books same dimensions across poses. Absolutely stable table width/height, four legs, lamp height and flower placement in every key. No perspective or camera change. Ample transparent gutters and outer margins, full scene incl boot soles/table legs/lamp/flowers inside every cell, no labels, captions, borders, floor, background, glow or watermarks.
full_scene_animation:
Create production hand-drawn START animation atlas for ArcPet Pomodoro, using the provided6-key storyboard as motion/construction reference and original character reference as authoritative identity/style. This replaces an unacceptable cutout animation: EVERY frame must draw the WHOLE character as one coherent anatomical figure, head naturally connected to neck/white collar, no independent head/body parts, no pasted feet, no giant bobblehead. Preserve warm straw-golden hair, red slit pupils, fine brown outlines, simple flat cel shadows, white plain sleeves/top, navy skirt, thick charcoal short legs/brown boots, golden gently curved tail. Match6-key reference's seated body proportions and tiny cat-shaped mouth. Original reference is not an instruction to use its jumping pose. Do not copy watermarks.
EXACTLY32 full-scene drawings arranged8columns x4rows in chronological reading order. Wide high-resolution sheet around3072x2048 if possible, with generous clear gutters and padding. EACH cell contains one complete unclipped portrait scene with cat AND small desk, lamp and daisies AND stool/boots/tablefeet. Genuine transparent background. No colored backdrop, gradient fog, labels, cell borders or floor.
LOCKED SCENE: same centered narrow walnut rectangular desk, tabletop level and width,4stout desklegs, same tiny unlit gooseneck lamp atfar LEFT, same3 white daisies in terracotta pot far RIGHT, same small stool BEHIND DESK, one darkgreen hardcover book in center. Same front camera/slight overhead tabletop view throughout. Tabletop/front apron occlude cat waist and upperthighs; skirt/stool/short legs/boots seen only in opening BELOW apron, behind it. Both forearms can reach FORWARD naturally over tabletop; paws and book are ABOVE table surface. NEVER a hand or book below apron, never legs sticking through desk or desklegs. All body components keep size. Character chin seamlessly meets collar in every frame. Table/legs/lamp/flowers must not grow, slide or change perspective. Keep desk top andfeet on identical local pixel rows in each cell. No shadows beneath desk.
32 genuinely different full-person drawings, NOT repeated poses. Motion is understated, continuous and single-play:
1-6 standing directly behind desk then gently bends knees and lowers onto stool, hands gently near tabletop, closed book already lies FLAT at center; head andtorso move down together15-20px at storyboard scale while neck stays connected, shoulderwidth andheadsize unchanged.
7-14 seated breathing: one smooth tiny inhale/exhale; chest/shoulders/cuffs shift about1-2% andhair ends have subtle followthrough. Everypose truly redrawn, no frozen wholebody. Hips and shortfeet stay supported atfixedheight. Calm parallel down gaze towardbook, no eye lift or blink sequence.
15-18 both arms extend a little forward to grasp LEFT/RIGHT sides of closedbook resting entirely on tabletop.
19-24 both paws lift closedbook smoothly from table to lowchest, gradually tilting horizontalcover toward reader: provide clear SMALL intermediate bookangles andgentle elbowbending. Bookcover andcream pageblock maintain consistent dimensions andvolume inperspective.
25-32 gradually opens greenbook andsettles holding it with bothpaws atloweroutercorners. Actual progressive cover angles andvisible cream pagewedge, not suddenly replacing closedbook with openbook. Book stays belowchin, andeyes remain looking gently down.
No readingloop, lookingup, flipping pages afteropen, hugegrin or blinking. No mechanical headrotation. No bodypart detachment/overlap, crossing arms, extra fingers, neck gap, changing haircolors/headsizes. Small coherent cel details, don't add blousefold clutter. Carefully compare all32 face/head/body proportions against same first-key character. Keep WHOLE characterandscene together, adequate padding even first frame cowlick andfinal deskfeet.
method: Built-in imagegen; each frame contains a whole character and scene. No character-part compositing.
